page_title: CEL 2-2 BAR | Celta Vigo v Barcelona 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

90+2' What an opportunity! Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the right side of the goal, but Inaki Pena reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
90+1' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Celta Vigo earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Iago Aspas.
89' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pau Victor (Barcelona) replacing Robert Lewandowski.
89' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Torre (Barcelona) is replacing Dani Olmo.
88' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) tries to find Raphinha, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
87' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

86' 2 - 2 Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Javier Rodriguez, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:2.
84' 1 - 2 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:2.
84' GOAL! No, cancel that as it has immediately been disallowed as the ball went out of play. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is disappointed his strike won’t count.
82' This was really stupid from Marc Casado (Barcelona)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Cesar Soto Grado.
80' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Hector Fort (Barcelona) is given a yellow card.
79' There's an opportunity for Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
78' A pass from Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by Inaki Pena and the move breaks down.
77' Raphinha (Barcelona) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
75' That's the end of the game for Fran Beltran, who is replaced by Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo).
75' Here's the change. Anastasios Douvikas leaves the pitch and Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) comes on as a substitute.
75' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Gavi and he is replaced by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona).
75' Pedri comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fermin Lopez (Barcelona).
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marc Casado (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Cesar Soto Grado didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' Neat link-up play between Jules Kounde (Barcelona) and Raphinha, but Vicente Guaita reads the game well and the move breaks down.
70' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
69' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the middle of the goal, but Inaki Pena is alert and thwarts the effort.
68' Marc Casado (Barcelona) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul. Celta Vigo get a free kick.
66' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) produces a good strike that sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
65' Pedri (Barcelona) picks out Dani Olmo with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.

64' He should have scored! Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Inaki Pena makes an easy save.
62' Substitution. Jonathan Bamba makes way for Alfonso Gonzalez (Celta Vigo).
61' 0 - 2 Goal! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
60' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) picks up a yellow card.
59' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
58' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
56' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
54' It looked like the long-range shot by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
50' The attendance for today's match is 24573.
49' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner with a short pass.
49' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
46' Hector Fort (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Hansi Flick probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Gerard Martin (Barcelona). He is replaced by Hector Fort.
46' Referee Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita was alert and the score remains the same.
43' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Dani Olmo (Barcelona), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
42' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
41' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
40' A pass into the penalty area from Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) is intercepted by the defence.
37' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is penalised for a foul. Cesar Soto Grado had a clear view and blows his whistle.
36' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
34' 5:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
31' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
29' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Raphinha (Barcelona) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
28' PENALTY APPEAL after Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

26' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
25' What a miskick by Marc Casado (Barcelona). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
24' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Vicente Guaita punches the ball away.
23' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
23' Raphinha (Barcelona) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will have a throw-in.
22' Raphinha (Barcelona) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Vicente Guaita was alert and made an astonishing save!
21' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
21' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
20' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

19' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives the ball and fires a first-time shot from long range. His brilliant effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Inaki Pena, who pulls off a stunning save! Celta Vigo earn a corner.
19' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
19' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Celta Vigo are awarded a corner kick.
18' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Raphinha (Barcelona), but the defence gets it clear.
15' 0 - 1 Goal! Jules Kounde puts a cross into the box and finds Raphinha (Barcelona), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
12' Pedri (Barcelona) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
12' Raphinha (Barcelona) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
10' Gavi (Barcelona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
9' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
4' Oscar Mingueza plays a lovely pass into Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), but he can't find the target. His strike from inside the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
4' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
3' The referee is firm and issues Gerard Martin (Barcelona) a deserved yellow card.
2' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) sends a long ball forward to Robert Lewandowski, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
